notes: The class profiles page shows its figures only once the Full-Time MBA button is selected, and on 2026-09-27 it showed a three-year average of the Classes of 2026, 2027 and 2028 and no single class; every class profile figure here is that average. Its served HTML also holds older blocks inside comments, such as a Class of 23, 24, 25 average, which the page does not show. No GMAT figure is published: the page's average of 694 and Poets&Quants' Class of 2027 median of 700 both name no edition (INC-0151). Acceptance rate not published on official pages. Employment statistics PDF is hosted on cdn.uconnectlabs.com, linked from the official Rice CDO reports page (cdo.business.rice.edu/outcomes/). The school's career highlights page for the same class states 146K average starting salary and 32K average signing bonus.
